entities.summary: Enmanuel Reyes Pla is a Spanish amateur boxer. Born in Cuba, he represents Spain internationally. He arrived in Spain in 2017 and became a naturalized citizen in 2020. He won a bronze medal in the men's heavyweight event at the 2020 Paris Olympics.
